faq.q: How much does Rejali Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Rejali Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Rejali Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Rejali Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Rejali Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Rejali Law Firm publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Rejali Law Firm?
faq.a: Rejali Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Rejali Law Firm publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Rejali Law Firm publishes 15 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
